topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Rain's been falling steady, like it’s trying to wash away the city. I’m sittin’ in my office, the walls closing in. The phone rings, and it’s this voice, hesitant, almost afraid. Says they found out their kid’s got the same teacher they did. Back when things were simpler. A time I barely recognize now, through the fog of years and the weight of the world. I nod, more to myself than to the person on the line, and a part of me, the part that remembers a different era, a different self, aches. “I understand,” I say, not sure if I do. “Same cycles, different years.” The line goes quiet, and the rain keeps falling, a relentless beat that echoes the rhythm of a heart that’s seen too much to be surprised.
